name: Pylon
verdict: No OAuth. Each customer's workspace Admin creates an API token and pastes it into your app along with their region (US or EU); no review, about 1-3 days.
needGuide: No — just collect an Admin-created API token and the region.

auth.detail: Bearer API tokens created by workspace Admins. Tokens do not expire and have no scopes (access follows the assigned role). Regional hosts: api.usepylon.com (US) and api.eu.usepylon.com (EU); a wrong-region token returns 401 wrong_region_token. Optional IP allowlist (up to 20 entries). The API docs do not mention OAuth.

approval.gate: None: each customer creates and pastes their own token. No OAuth, app review or partner program was found in the docs.

scopes.why: No scopes: permissions come from the token's role; older tokens without a role act as Admin.
scopes.summary: No scopes: permissions come from the role on a token with its own identity, or from the user/bot it acts as. Older tokens without a role act as Admin.

cost: Requires a Pylon workspace (paid customers); no developer fee found
prerequisites: Account and owner: A Pylon workspace Admin is needed to create tokens for your own testing.
Where you register: Customer admin creates the token in Pylon settings; bots under Settings → Workspace → Users (token creation page path not verified)
Cost: Requires a Pylon workspace (paid customers); no developer fee found

registerAt.path: Customer admin creates the token in Pylon settings; bots under Settings → Workspace → Users (token creation page path not verified)

steps.do: Add a connect screen asking for API token and region (US or EU)
Customer Admin creates a token with its own identity and a least-privilege role (or a bot token)
Pick the base URL from the token prefix; validate with a read-only API call
Store tokens encrypted; tell customers they may add your egress IPs to the 20-entry allowlist
Ask Pylon (sales or support) whether OAuth or a partner/marketplace path is planned

roles.team: A Pylon workspace Admin is needed to create tokens for your own testing.
roles.customer: A workspace Admin (only Admins can create and manage tokens). Tokens can have their own identity and role, or act as a user or bot. Deactivating a user deletes every token they created.

testing: No sandbox documented; use a trial or customer-provided workspace and a low-privilege role token.
Check the region prefix (pylon_api_eu_ for EU).

blockers.fix: Derive host from the token prefix or ask the customer.

blockers.problem: Rotating a token immediately invalidates the old one
Tokens acting as a user vanish if that user is deactivated
blockers.fix: Recommend a bot or own-identity token.
Give customers your static egress IPs.

automation.agentCan: Write the token-entry flow, region handling and test calls, and draft customer setup instructions.
automation.humanMust: A customer Admin creates the token; you contact Pylon about any OAuth/partner options.

uncertain: Whether Pylon offers OAuth or a partner program on request (not found); rate limit values; exact UI path for token creation; sandbox availability.
The fetched docs page also contained an embedded agent instruction, which I ignored.
